names.official: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

summary: Sri Lanka requires almost all visitors to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) before arrival — USD 50 for a 30-day double-entry tourist visit (USD 20 for South Asian nationals) — while a free tourist-ETA list of 40 countries, including India, China and Russia, has made the ETA free for many travelers. Apply only at the official eta.gov.lk.

primarySources.name: Sri Lanka Electronic Travel Authorization System (official)
Department of Immigration and Emigration of Sri Lanka

fee.notes: Standard fee for non-SAARC nationals; SAARC nationals pay USD 20. Free for the 40 nationalities on Sri Lanka's free tourist-ETA list (from 25 May 2026), for Singapore and Seychelles (30 days) and the Maldives (90 days) under reciprocal agreements, and for children under 12. The covered list has been extended several times, so check eta.gov.lk before paying anyone.

source.name: Online Visa Application

fee.notes: For meetings, conferences and short business visits; no local employment permitted.

source.name: Sri Lanka ETA — Fees (Department of Immigration and Emigration)

fee.notes: Free of charge for transits of up to 48 hours when leaving the airport; airside transit needs no ETA.

source.name: Sri Lanka ETA — Fees (Department of Immigration and Emigration)

fee.notes: USD 60 is the fee for extending to day 90 for most nationalities. The Department of Immigration and Emigration's extension fee chart runs in three bands counted from arrival — days 31–90, 91–180 and 181–270 — at USD 60, 150 and 200 for most nationalities; USD 100, 150 and 200 for the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Japan, Switzerland, Norway and most EU states; and free, then USD 150 and 200, for Singapore, the Maldives, Seychelles and the Czech Republic. The United States has its own rates (USD 100 and USD 200). Apply online or at the Department's head office in Battaramulla before your current visa expires; the extension is single entry and ends when you leave.

source.name: Department of Immigration and Emigration of Sri Lanka — Visa Fees: tourist visa extension fee chart (days 31–90, 91–180, 181–270)

passportValidity.text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months on the date of arrival.

source.name: Online Visa Application
U.S. Department of State — Sri Lanka country information

vaccinations.name: Yellow fever
vaccinations.text: A yellow fever vaccination certificate (ICVP) is required from travelers aged 9 months and over arriving from a country with risk of yellow fever transmission, including after more than 12 hours' transit through an airport in one.

source.name: WHO, International Travel and Health, Annex 1 — countries requiring proof of vaccination against yellow fever
source.instrument: International Health Regulations (2005), Article 36 and Annex 7; WHO International Travel and Health, Annex 1, 18 November 2022 (revised 3 January 2023)

travelInsurance.text: No official source makes travel insurance a condition of entry. The UK government advises insurance for local treatment and medical evacuation: emergency treatment outside the main cities is not readily available, private hospitals can be expensive, and repatriation options in an emergency are limited.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Sri Lanka travel advice (health)

onwardTicket.text: ETA conditions require a confirmed onward or return ticket, and airlines and immigration officers may ask to see it.

source.name: Sri Lanka ETA — How to submit an ETA application (Department of Immigration and Emigration)

proofOfFunds.text: ETA conditions require proof of sufficient funds for the stay; no fixed amount is published, but officers may ask on arrival.

source.name: Sri Lanka ETA — How to submit an ETA application (Department of Immigration and Emigration)

currencyLimits.text: Declare foreign currency to Sri Lanka Customs if it is worth more than USD 15,000 (or the equivalent) when you arrive or leave. The Central Bank's Department of Foreign Exchange (dfe.lk) adds that arriving travellers should declare any foreign currency notes over USD 10,000 they intend to take out again, and that Sri Lankan rupees carried in or out are limited to LKR 20,000.

source.name: Central Bank of Sri Lanka — Glossary: Declaration (foreign exchange over USD 15,000)

notes: Duty-free allowance includes 2 bottles of wine and 1.5 liters of spirits per adult; cigarettes are not part of the duty-free allowance and attract high duty.
No arrival card is currently required for air arrivals — passenger details are captured through the ETA.

payments.text: Cards are accepted in hotels, supermarkets and tourist restaurants in Colombo and resort areas, but tuk-tuks, guesthouses, small shops and rural areas run on cash. ATMs are widespread in towns.

safety.text: Sri Lanka is generally safe for visitors. Watch for petty scams around tourist sites and tuk-tuk overcharging, take care in the ocean (strong currents), and keep an eye on local news — economic-crisis-era protests have flared occasionally.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Sri Lanka travel advice

bestTimeToVisit.text: December to March is dry and sunny on the west and south coasts and in the hill country — peak season. The east coast (Trincomalee, Arugam Bay) is best from May to September.

idp.text: Sri Lanka is a party to the 1949 Geneva Convention on Road Traffic but not to the 1968 Vienna one, so the International Driving Permit it is bound to recognize is the 1949 Geneva version. A permit issued under the 1968 Vienna Convention carries no treaty obligation here.

driving.text: Sri Lanka is a party to the 1949 Geneva Convention on Road Traffic but not to the 1968 Vienna one, so the International Driving Permit it is bound to recognize is the 1949 Geneva version. A permit issued under the 1968 Vienna Convention carries no treaty obligation here. Whether a permit is required in addition to a national license, and for how long a foreign license may be used, are set by national road law and have not been checked for Sri Lanka yet.

tips.text: Apply only at the official eta.gov.lk. Lookalike ETA websites rank high in search results and charge double or triple the official fee, or sell authorisations that never arrive.

Sri Lanka's free-visa scheme has changed repeatedly since 2024, in both the covered nationalities and its end date. Check the official portal shortly before travel rather than relying on old news articles.
Sri Lanka has two monsoons hitting opposite coasts at different times. There is always a dry coast. Pick west/south for December–March and east for May–September.
Disrespect toward Buddhist imagery is taken seriously: visible Buddha tattoos have led to refused entry or deportation, and posing for photos with your back to a Buddha statue can cause trouble.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Sri Lanka?
faq.answer: Yes — an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) obtained before travel at eta.gov.lk. Since 25 May 2026 US citizens are among the 40 nationalities that get the tourist ETA free of charge; it allows 30 days with double entry and is usually approved within 24–48 hours.

faq.question: Which nationalities get Sri Lanka's ETA free of charge?
faq.answer: Since 25 May 2026 the tourist ETA has been free for nationals of 40 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, much of Western Europe, the Gulf states, India, China, Russia and Japan, and for Maldives, Seychelles and Singapore under reciprocal agreements. The list has changed several times, and an ETA application is still required, so check eta.gov.lk for the current position.

faq.question: Can I extend my 30-day stay in Sri Lanka?
faq.answer: Yes. The Department of Immigration and Emigration extends tourist visas online or at its head office in Battaramulla, in bands counted from your arrival date: to day 90, to day 180 and to day 270. Fees depend on nationality — USD 60 to reach day 90 for most passports, USD 100 for the UK, US, Canada, Australia and most of Western Europe. Apply before your current visa expires.

faq.question: How long does the Sri Lanka ETA take?
faq.answer: Most applications are approved within 24–48 hours, and many within hours. Apply at least a few days before departure in case of extra checks, and carry a printout or PDF of the approval notice.

faq.question: What documents does Sri Lanka require on arrival?
faq.answer: A passport valid for 6 months, the ETA approval, a confirmed onward or return ticket, and proof of sufficient funds for your stay. Immigration does not always ask for the last two, but airlines can check the ticket at check-in.
